Rust Eater (CV 16)

A low armored scavenger sweeps feathery antennae over metal, leaving orange dust where it feeds.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 18 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 1

Evasion: None · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Oxide feelers

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Slowed 2. Standard defense: Slowed 1.

Corrosive Smear

A sticky film clings to boots and joints, slowing each movement with a gritty drag.

One adjacent creature gains Slowed 1. Once per turn; no immediate damage. This does not destroy equipment, reduce resistance or change inventory permanently.

Clinging Recoil

The cut sprays sticky droplets that stretch into threads across the attacker's hands and boots.

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Slow a nearby intruder and return to exposed metal once left alone. Its combat film does not erase armor, weapons or coins.

Encounter and conversation: It is attracted to a hidden iron deposit beneath a home, not to the household itself.

Habitat: Cavern; forgotten laboratory; buried ruin · Communication: Common

Loot: Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
